say:1:1013611001:3.text: What kind of tasks does the Adamant Syndicate usually give you?
say:1:1013611001:3.source_cn: 黑金商会日常都让你们做些什么？

say:2:1013611002:0.text: Curious, huh? You want a piece of the pie, don't you?
say:2:1013611002:0.source_cn: 原来各位是想知道这个。莫非也打算分一杯羹？呃，可是我们...
say:2:1013611002:0.male: Curious, huh? You want a piece of the pie, don't you?
say:2:1013611002:0.female: Curious, huh? You want a piece of the pie, don't you?

say:3:1013611003:1.text: Alright, I'll tell you. We've mostly just been transporting treasures to their camps and putting things together.
say:3:1013611003:1.source_cn: 除了帮黑金运送宝物去他们的营地，派几个人去组装一些东西...
say:3:1013611003:1.male: Alright, I'll tell you. We've mostly just been transporting treasures to their camps and putting things together.
say:3:1013611003:1.female: Alright, I'll tell you. We've mostly just been transporting treasures to their camps and putting things together.

say:4:1013611004:1.text: We've pretty much explored all the nearby ruins! Oh, except for the Sun Temple.
say:4:1013611004:1.source_cn: 毕竟这附近的遗迹我们都摸透了！哦，日神殿除外。
say:4:1013611004:1.male: We've pretty much explored all the nearby ruins! Oh, except for the Sun Temple.
say:4:1013611004:1.female: We've pretty much explored all the nearby ruins! Oh, except for the Sun Temple.

say:5:1013611005:1.source_cn: 日神殿……有什么特殊之处吗？

say:6:1013611006:1.text: The Syndicate locked down that whole area. Probably hoarding all that treasure to themselves!
say:6:1013611006:1.source_cn: 还不是黑金的人独霸着那块地方，不让我们过去。多半是想独...

say:9:1013611008:1.text: We're not entirely sure about the details, but it seems like that! Otherwise, why would they guard it so fiercely?
say:9:1013611008:1.source_cn: 具体的我们也不清楚，只是看着像这么回事！不然，日神殿里...
